messages:
marta: heads-up: deploy-bot stopped the payments promotion due to chart-version mismatch across regions. holding canary until we pick a path.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] Promotion paused: chart version mismatch. service=payments; eu-west=chart-v1.13.0 (promoted); us-east=chart-v1.11.9 (current); reason=preflight values-schema check failed in us-east.

jamie: @marta was this a staggered promotion or manual? any image errors?

marta: Staggered. no image errors. helm preflight in us-east failed schema validation for values.yaml, so promotion was skipped there.

owen: Options: 1) pin eu-west back to known-good (v1.12.0) temporarily, 2) rollback eu-west to v1.11.9, or 3) patch v1.13.0 with schema-compatible defaults. Pin buys us time.

sanjay: +1 pin for 30-60m and run validation in us-east. then decide. :thumbsup: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-oncall: If you choose rollback we can open a rollback window in ~10m. also need concise release-note delta so SRE can evaluate DB/conn impact. @jamie

jamie: release note excerpt: "default job concurrency bumped 5 -> 10; may increase DB connections under bursty loads." that's the only config change in v1.13.0.

marta: @deploy-bot list affected namespaces and helm history for payments in us-east so we can pick pin vs rollback.

deploy-bot: affected namespaces: payments-prod, payments-staging. helm history (payments, us-east): REV 45 -> chart-v1.11.9. helm history (payments, eu-west): REV 46 -> chart-v1.13.0.

owen: running a quick schema validation in us-east: `kubectl -n payments run canary-schema-check --image=ci/payment-check:latest --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c "./validate-schema.sh"` will post results in ~5m.

marta: proposed immediate plan: 1) create a temporary pin in eu-west to v1.12.0 for 30m, 2) run validation in us-east, 3) if validation passes, patch v1.13.0 to revert the concurrency default and re-promote. I'll create the pin and follow up.

jamie: ack, creating patch branch to revert default concurrency now and will attach CI logs.

deploy-bot: promotion hold recorded (initiator=marta). pin request created for eu-west: service=payments; target=chart-v1.12.0; duration=30m. to remove: `/deploybot unpin payments eu-west`.

marta: executing the pin now, will post confirmation once live.
